name: Ningbo Hicon Industry Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Hicon Industry Technology Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and markets household refrigeration appliances. It offers beer KEG fridges, chest freezers, ice makers, ice maker with water dispensers, party coolers, upright freezers, wine/beverage coolers, water dispensers, refrigerators, freezers, and small appliances, as well as household and medical air conditioners and portable air conditioners. The company also provides after sales services. It exports in the Unites States, Germany, Canada, Japan, Korea, the United Kingdom, France, Spain, and Mexico. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Ningbo, China.
